content.text: {"sql":"SELECT date_trunc('week', event_ts)::DATE AS week_start, event_type, COALESCE(app_version, '(unknown)') AS app_version, COALESCE(reject_reason, '(none)') AS reject_reason, COUNT(*) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN attempt IS NOT NULL THEN user_id END) AS users_with_attempt, MAX(attempt) AS max_attempt FROM funnel_events WHERE event_ts >= DATE '2025-09-01' AND event_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-16' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4","rationale":"This weekly breakdown of recent funnel events by type, app version, and rejection reason will show where KYC activity changed and whether the shift aligns with a release or specific failure reasons."}
